title: AI驱动云计算结构性重构：从绿色基础设施与主权AI部署到垂直行业应用深化
core_insight: 云厂商正加速AI原生基础设施重构，Google Cloud实现AI算力碳效率重大突破，微软与AWS分别推进主权AI边缘部署和企业级AI治理，同时火山引擎等厂商向短剧等垂直行业深度渗透，显示云计算向高效、合规与行业化三轨并进

dimension_texts.technology: Google Cloud发布Envoy网络架构优化，为Agentic AI环境重新设计网络责任分配；Cloudflare推出Dynamic Workers实现AI代理代码安全沙箱执行，速度提升100倍；AWS推出ECS Managed Daemons提升云原生运维效率 Google Cloud推出Veo 3.1 Lite视频模型和Gemma 4开源模型，在Vertex AI平台上实现成本优化和性能提升；Cloudflare重新设计AI时代的缓存架构以应对每周超100亿次AI机器人请求；火山引擎DeerFlow 2.0开源升级提升Agent执行稳定性 Envoy: A future-ready foundation for agentic AI networking Sandboxing AI agents, 100x faster Announcing managed daemon support for Amazon ECS Managed Instances Introducing Veo 3.1 Lite and a new Veo upscaling capability on Vertex AI Why we're rethinking cache for the AI era DeerFlow 2.0 开源升级：依托 Harness，让 Agent 不再"半途而废" What’s new with Microsoft in open-source and Kubernetes at KubeCon + CloudNativeCon Europe 2026 Announcing Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL serverless database creation in seconds
dimension_texts.infrastructure: 微软与Armada合作推出Azure Local on Galleon模块化数据中心，支持主权AI在边缘环境部署；Cloudflare推出Organizations功能帮助企业规模化管理多账户；微软强调数字主权作为区域化战略核心 Google Cloud Ironwood TPUs实现3.7倍碳效率提升，在AI基础设施能效方面取得重大突破；Cloudflare Gen 13服务器采用AMD EPYC Turin 9965处理器并升级至100GbE网络，应对流量增长需求 AI infrastructure efficiency: Ironwood TPUs deliver 3.7x carbon efficiency gains Building sovereign AI at the edge: Microsoft and Armada collaborate to deliver Azure Local on Galleon modular datacenters How we built Organizations to help enterprises manage Cloudflare at scale Inside Gen 13: how we built our most powerful server yet Navigating digital sovereignty at the frontier of transformation
dimension_texts.application: 火山引擎进入短剧生产领域，推出'火山剧创'Agent；微软宣布AI for nuclear合作，将AI技术应用于核能行业；Salesforce展示Engine公司在旅游行业使用Agentforce平台部署自主旅行支持应用 AWS推出独立的可持续性控制台，整合范围1-3碳排放报告；HubSpot密集发布AI内容优化、邮件个性化等营销自动化工具；Google Cloud Looker平台新增自服务探索和对话式分析功能 接入Seedance 2.0，短剧生产Agent「火山剧创」正式邀测 AI for nuclear energy: Powering an intelligent, resilient future Engine Delivers Autonomous Travel Support with Hybrid Development on the Agentforce 360 Platform Announcing the AWS Sustainability console AI-driven email personalization strategies that actually work How Honeylove boosts product quality and service efficiency with BigQuery Introducing Looker self-service Explores for faster ad-hoc analysis ArkClaw 适配微信，可以在微信上指挥你的龙虾啦
dimension_texts.capital: Strella完成1400万美元A轮融资，Amazon和Chobani采用其AI访谈技术，显示AI驱动客户研究工具获得市场认可 暂无重大并购消息，但AI初创企业融资活跃，反映资本继续流向AI应用层创新 大厂主要通过产品迭代和技术合作巩固市场地位，而非大规模并购 Amazon and Chobani adopt Strella's AI interviews for customer research as fast-growing startup raises $14M
dimension_texts.risk: 伊朗威胁攻击美国关联的AI数据中心（'Stargate'），凸显地缘政治风险；微软将数字主权作为风险管理核心议题；主权AI边缘部署反映对数据主权和合规性要求的响应 North Korea黑客攻击流行开源项目，提醒软件供应链安全风险；Kai-Fu Lee警告美国在AI硬件战争中已落后于中国；Cloudflare推出Programmable Flow Protection应对复杂DDoS威胁 Iran threatens 'Stargate' AI data centers North Korea's hijack of one of the web's most used open source projects was likely weeks in the making Kai-Fu Lee's brutal assessment: America is already losing the AI hardware war to China Navigating digital sovereignty at the frontier of transformation Introducing Programmable Flow Protection: custom DDoS mitigation logic for Magic Transit customers Building sovereign AI at the edge
